verdict.rationale: Mailchimp's own materials list automations as a core feature, including 'Enhanced automations' on the pricing page and Analytics AI reporting on which automations drive revenue. RSS campaigns are documented to send on their own schedule, and a community user mentions working on a Mailchimp automation. However, the evidence is only thin marketing mentions, with no documentation of how automations are triggered, configured or run unattended. Missing for 10: documentation of automation triggers and workflow setup, evidence of AI-driven or agent-configured automations, API control of automations, and hands-on corroboration of reliable background execution.
